title: Deep learning-based structural prediction (AlphaFold 3) of shrimp IMNV RdRp and identification of seaweed-derived metabolites for antiviral intervention in aquaculture.
authors: Rahman, Mostafizur; Ali, Md Ahad; Samara, Tahosin Tasneem; Saha, Monish; Kundu, Pritom; Sarker, Hriddhi; Dutta, Ankita; Kumar, Neeraj
one_liner_zh: 该文使用AlphaFold 3预测虾病毒RdRp结构，并结合分子对接和MD模拟筛选海藻代谢物抑制剂，属于蛋白质结构预测与对接的工程化应用，方法创新性一般，但问题和方法与课题相关。
abstract: Infectious Myonecrosis Virus (IMNV) remains a major global threat to shrimp aquaculture, causing severe economic losses due to the lack of approved antiviral therapeutics. In this study, an advanced in silico approach was employed, utilizing a deep learning-based prediction of AlphaFold 3 protein structures and large-scale virtual screening of seaweed-derived metabolites to identify potential inhibitors targeting RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp). To identify potential seaweed-derived candidate compounds against IMNV, a total of 1,077 compounds were screened against the RdRp_M01 protein. The docking results suggest the top-ranked three bioactive compounds, such as GA002 (-13.0 kcal/mol), RC003 (-10.9 kcal/mol), and BE012 (-10.8 kcal/mol), based on their highest binding energy score and molecular interactions, for further analysis. The 200 ns molecular dynamics simulations showed that the selected complexes exhibited stable behavior throughout the simulation time, with relatively low standard deviation values. Post-simulation MMGBSA analysis revealed total binding free energies (DeltaG_total) of -24.726, -26.722, and -34.850 kcal/mol for RdRp_M01_GA002, RdRp_M01_RC003, and RdRp_M01_BE012, respectively, indicating favorable binding affinity and stable protein-ligand interactions. The drug-likeness and physicochemical profiles of the selected compounds were acceptable, supporting their further investigation. Therefore, further validation through in vitro and in vivo studies is necessary to confirm their applicability in shrimp systems and to explore the potential of seaweed metabolites as candidate compounds targeting the IMNV RdRp and alternatives to synthetic drugs.
abstract_zh: 传染性肌坏死病毒（Infectious Myonecrosis Virus, IMNV）仍是全球对虾养殖业的主要威胁，由于缺乏已批准的抗病毒治疗药物，导致严重的经济损失。本研究采用了一种先进的计算模拟方法，利用基于深度学习的AlphaFold 3蛋白质结构预测和大型虚拟筛选海藻来源代谢物，以识别靶向RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶（RNA-dependent RNA polymerase, RdRp）的潜在抑制剂。为筛选针对IMNV的潜在海藻来源候选化合物，共对1,077种化合物进行了针对RdRp_M01蛋白的筛选。对接结果表明，排名前三的生物活性化合物，如GA002（-13.0 kcal/mol）、RC003（-10.9 kcal/mol）和BE012（-10.8 kcal/mol），基于其最高结合能评分和分子相互作用，被选作进一步分析。200 ns分子动力学模拟显示，所选复合物在整个模拟时间内表现出稳定行为，且标准偏差值相对较低。模拟后的MMGBSA分析显示，RdRp_M01_GA002、RdRp_M01_RC003和RdRp_M01_BE012的总结合自由能（DeltaG_total）分别为-24.726、-26.722和-34.850 kcal/mol，表明其具有有利的结合亲和力和稳定的蛋白质-配体相互作用。所选化合物的药物相似性和理化特性可接受，支持其进一步研究。因此，有必要通过体外和体内研究进行进一步验证，以确认其在对虾系统中的适用性，并探索海藻代谢物作为靶向IMNV RdRp的候选化合物及合成药物替代品的潜力。
